endorsements.name: Kislay Kumar
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-36954
endorsements.description: Xeroneit Library Management System 3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Book Category feature that allows administrators to inject malicious scripts. Attackers can insert a payload in the Category Name field to execute arbitrary JavaScript code when the page is loaded.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.4)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Kislay Kumar
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37240
endorsements.description: Queue Management System 4.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject malicious scripts through user creation fields. Attackers can insert JavaScript payloads in the First Name, Last Name, and Email fields during user creation, which execute when viewing the User List page.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.4)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
